Finding Title: Critical Risk: Exposed Windows Update Delivery Optimization on Port 7680/TCP
Description: TCP port 7680 was confirmed in the OPEN state via TCP SYN/connect handshake. Protocol probing extracted banner: "Windows Update Delivery Optimization". Identified software product: Windows. Mapped host process: svchost.exe (PID: 2656). Correlated against NIST NVD with top matching advisory CVE-1999-0241 (CVSS 10.0) (Critical severity).
Remediation: Configure Windows Update Delivery Optimization (WUDO) to local network peer sharing only or disable via Group Policy.
